integrity: The proof independently derives the exact cube-slab H-description from the published vertex definition, then converts ball containment into four scalar interval-intersection inequalities. The complete incenter locus and uniqueness criterion are obtained directly from the equality cases. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to consecutive-layer S-hypersimplices in the standard coordinate realization, with d>=2 and 0<=a<b<=d. It does not cover nonconsecutive S, affine images, or non-Euclidean norms. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent folklore Chebyshev-center observation for cube-slab intersections.
title: Four barriers determine the exact Euclidean inradius of consecutive-layer S-hypersimplices
